Skipping PyByteArray_Resize(obj, 0) is equivalent, because a shrink to 0 cannot fail. WriterFinish pins both ValueErrors and success from any size Create gives, for either type. The bytes returned are the caller's by the Writer's construction (see byteswriter_resize).

name: PyBytesWriter_Finish
reason: FinishWithSize(writer, writer->size), which writerFinish covers when the caller's bytes have that length; WriterFinish pins it.

name: PyBytesWriter_FinishWithPointer
reason: The size is buf - data, the length of what the caller wrote. WriterFinish pins writerFinish w out = out after a successful check, and the refusal past size.

name: PyBytesWriter_GetData
reason: The no-behaviour: reason applies, as for byteswriter_data.

name: PyBytesWriter_GetSize
reason: The trivial: reason applies: _PyBytesWriter_GetSize is return writer->size (pycore_bytesobject.h:108-111), one field with no branch.

name: PyBytesWriter_Resize
reason: writerResize mirrors :3963-3976: the negative ValueError, an overallocating resize only when growing, and size set either way. WriterInvariant pins size and capacity after success, and WriterGrowth pins success below 2^46 and the refusal.

name: _PyBytesWriter_ResizeAndUpdatePointer
reason: writerResizeAt keeps the offset across PyBytesWriter_Resize (:3985-3989), and WriterInvariant pins the offset, the size and the capacity.

name: PyBytesWriter_Grow
reason: writerGrow mirrors :3998-4022: grow 0, the PY_SSIZE_T_MAX - size MemoryError, the 'invalid size' ValueError, then the overallocating resize. WriterInvariant and WriterGrowth pin each arm and success below 2^46.

name: PyBytesWriter_GrowAndUpdatePointer
reason: writerGrowAt keeps the offset across Grow (:4030-4034), and WriterInvariant pins it.

name: PyBytesWriter_WriteBytes
reason: writerWriteBytes mirrors :4042-4056: strlen for a negative size (the > PY_SSIZE_T_MAX MemoryError cannot fire), Grow, then the copy at the old size. WriterInvariant pins the appended data, the size and the capacity, given at least size bytes, the documented precondition.

name: PyBytesWriter_Format
reason: writerFormat follows :4066-4084: Grow(strlen(format)), bytes_fromformat at the old size, the undo of writer->size on its failure (:4077-4081), then Resize to the end of the text. WriterFormatRules pins the text as bytesFromFormat's (and FromFormatConv pins that per conversion), the size moved by its length, and the size and output unchanged on any error. Folding the grows of WRITE_BYTES into the final Resize changes only how much is allocated.

name: _PyBytesWriter_ResizeToAllocated
reason: writerResizeToAllocated sets size to the allocation and nothing else (:4094-4098), as WriterInvariant's last conjunct states. It cannot fail, as the comment says.
